title: Normalized punctured root-tower coordinate-face diagram
statement:
Fix distinct primes $p,\ell$, a characteristic-$p$ field $k$, a finite norm-topological extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and an algebraic closure $\Omega\supset E$ with its extended norm topology. For $F=E,\Omega$ use the condensed ring $C_F(P)=C(P,F)$ of all continuous maps, its pullbacks $C_{F,X}=p_X^*C_F$, and internal modules and ordinary unbounded derived direct images [def-sfb-continuous-map-condensed-ring, sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients, sk-def-sfb-module-objects, sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull]. Sites are small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site].
Let $Y$ be a regular separated finite-type $k$-scheme and $B\to Y$ an affine etale chart with boundary the reduced strict normal crossings divisor $V(t_1\cdots t_r)$, whose branches are exactly $V(t_d)$ [def-weil-regular-scheme, def-trf-strict-normal-crossings-boundary]. Let $U=\operatorname{Spec}R\to B$ be affine pro-etale, put $S=U\times_B V(t_1,\ldots,t_r)$, and set
$$T=\operatorname{Spec}\left(\varinjlim_{(n,p)=1}R[x_{d,n}]_{1\le d\le r}/(x_{d,n}^n-t_d)_d\right).$$
The index consists of positive integers prime to $p$, ordered by divisibility, and the transition for $n\mid m$ sends $x_{d,n}$ to $x_{d,m}^{m/n}$. Let $i:S\to T$ set every root to zero. Partition $\{1,\ldots,r\}=I_o\sqcup I_i$ with $I_i\ne\varnothing$. Let $V\subset U$ invert all outer parameters and let $W\subset V$ invert all parameters. Put $T^\circ=T\times_UW$. Write $a:V\hookrightarrow U$ and let $h:Z\hookrightarrow V$ be the reduced closed complement of $W$ in $V$.
Let $\mathcal N$ be a finite-rank lisse $C_{F,T}$-module [def-sfb-lisse-coefficient-module]. For a profinite set $P$ let $\mathcal N_P$ denote its pullbacks to $T[P]$ and its restrictions [def-sfb-profinite-test-objects]. Let $q_P:T[P]\to U$ and $f_P:T^\circ[P]\to V$ be structural, and set $H_P=Rq_{P,*}\mathcal N_P[0]$ and $K_P=Rf_{P,*}\mathcal N_P[0]$.
Both $K_P$ and $H_P$ have zero cohomology in negative degrees.
For every nonempty $J\subseteq I_i$ put $U_J=\operatorname{Spec}(R/(t_j)_{j\in J})$, $V_J=U_J\times_U V$, with closed inclusions $g_J:U_J\hookrightarrow U$, $d_J:V_J\hookrightarrow V$. There are natural isomorphisms
$$\lambda_P:Ra_*K_P\xrightarrow{\sim}H_P,\qquad \mu_{J,P}:Ra_*d_{J,*}d_J^*K_P\xrightarrow{\sim}g_{J,*}g_J^*H_P.$$
Here $\lambda_P$ is the inverse of the pushed-forward actual open unit for $T^\circ[P]\hookrightarrow T[P]$, using canonical derived composition. If $u_{J,P}:K_P\to d_{J,*}d_J^*K_P$ and $v_{J,P}:H_P\to g_{J,*}g_J^*H_P$ are the actual closed units [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-ringed-open-closed], then
$$\mu_{J,P}\circ Ra_*(u_{J,P})=v_{J,P}\circ\lambda_P.$$
For $J\subseteq J'$ the isomorphisms $\mu$ intertwine the actual successive closed restriction maps, so these equations identify the entire augmented finite face diagrams. They are natural in $P$, in maps of supplied lisse modules, and under pro-etale base change of $U$. They commute with root-tower automorphisms preserving the indicated faces and opens, with the supplied equivariant module actions, and with profinite families of such automorphisms: a family indexed by $Q$ gives equality on the entire $Q$-parametrized terms. Empty outer set, empty charts, and rank zero are included. No boundary trivialization or internal Hom comparison is assumed or concluded.

proof.text: Use [lem-sfb-internal-module-operations-transport] and [lem-weil-pbc-ring-sheaves-grothendieck] to work in Grothendieck module categories with their actual adjunctions. They have enough injectives by [lem-sp-grothendieck-enough-injectives]. By [lem-weil-pbc-left-exact-injective-resolution-degree-zero] choose injective resolutions of the degree-zero modules on $T[P]$ and $T^\circ[P]$ supported in degrees $\geq0$. They are K-injective by [lem-sp-kinjective-computes], and compute the ordinary unbounded direct images [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull]. The direct images are additive and left exact by [def-sfb-module-lower-star]. Applying them termwise leaves zero terms in negative degrees. Hence $H_P,K_P\in D^{\geq0}$.

source.place: Paragraph (3), agent normalized face-diagram assembly, step 1

proof.text:
Suppress $P$ in the notation. Put $T_V=T	imes_U V$, with $b:T_V[P]\hookrightarrow T[P]$, $c:T^\circ[P]\hookrightarrow T_V[P]$, and $q_V:T_V[P]	o V$. Write $A=Rq_{V,*}(b^*\mathcal N_P)[0]$. [lem-sfb-root-tower-profinite-base-change] identifies these as the indicated root towers and opens. The units for $b$ and $bc$ are invertible by [lem-sfb-root-tower-puncture-invariance], with subsets $I_o$ and all indices. The unit for $c$ is their restriction to the outer open; the open-slice comparison [lem-sfb-module-direct-image-open-pasting], derived using [lem-sfb-kinjective-direct-image-open-word-model], identifies this restriction with the same actual unit by [lem-sfb-clean-open-unit-parametrized-exchange]. The required coefficient identifications are [lem-sfb-alpha-iso]. Thus their pushed units give isomorphisms $
u:H_P	o Ra_*A$ and $\kappa:A	o K_P$. By [lem-sfb-derived-composition-adjunction-normalization] their composite $
u_{m all}=(Ra_*\kappa)
u$ is the pushed actual unit for $bc$. Define $\lambda_P=
u_{m all}^{-1}$.

source.place: Paragraph (3), agent normalized face-diagram assembly, step 2

proof.text: For $J\subseteq I_i$ use the zero-root face $e_J:T_J[P]\to T[P]$ and put $N_J=e_J^*\mathcal N_P$, $H_J=Rq_{J,*}N_J[0]$. Write $T_{J,V}=T_J\times_U V$, $b_J:T_{J,V}[P]\hookrightarrow T_J[P]$, $a_J:V_J\hookrightarrow U_J$, and $H_{J,V}=Rq_{J,V,*}(N_J|_{T_{J,V}[P]})[0]$. The restriction $N_J$ is lisse: exact coefficient pullback preserves its finite-free local trivializations, using [det-prop-sfb-module-pullback-exact-main] and [def-sfb-lisse-coefficient-module]. Apply [lem-sfb-residual-root-tower-local-charts] to $J$. On each resulting open chart $T_J[P]$ is a full root tower over an affine pro-etale regular SNC chart, and $b_J$ inverts precisely its active outer parameters. [lem-sfb-root-tower-puncture-invariance] makes its actual unit invertible there. Restriction to these opens commutes with derived direct images: apply the open-slice isomorphism [lem-sfb-module-direct-image-open-pasting] to K-injectives using [lem-sfb-kinjective-direct-image-open-word-model]; coefficient isomorphisms are [lem-sfb-alpha-iso]. The cone of the unit has zero cohomology on this open cover, hence its cohomology sheaves vanish by the sheaf gluing axiom. Therefore the unit is globally invertible. Pushing it gives $\omega_J:H_J\xrightarrow{\sim}Ra_{J,*}H_{J,V}$.

source.place: Paragraph (3), agent normalized face-diagram assembly, step 3

proof.text:
The counit-normalized isomorphisms of [lem-sfb-root-tower-coordinate-face], over $U$ and after restriction to $V$, are $\beta_U:g_J^*H_P\xrightarrow{\sim}H_J$ and $\beta_V:d_J^*A\xrightarrow{\sim}H_{J,V}$. For the latter restriction use the open-slice/K-injective comparisons of step 3; the node explicitly includes open restriction. Closed direct images are exact by [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-ringed-open-closed]: the complement of $U_J$ is the finite union $\bigcup_{j\in J}D(t_j)$ of quasi-compact principal opens, and the same holds in $V$. Set $\tau_J$ to be the composite
$$Ra_*d_{J,*}d_J^*K_P\xrightarrow{Ra_*d_{J,*}d_J^*\kappa^{-1}}Ra_*d_{J,*}d_J^*A\xrightarrow{Ra_*d_{J,*}\beta_V}g_{J,*}Ra_{J,*}H_{J,V}\xrightarrow{g_{J,*}\omega_J^{-1}}g_{J,*}H_J.$$
The middle arrow inserts $ad_J=g_Ja_J$ and [lem-sfb-derived-composition-adjunction-normalization]. Define $\mu_{J,P}=(g_{J,*}\beta_U^{-1})\tau_J$. Every arrow is invertible, so this is the asserted derived isomorphism.

source.place: Paragraph (3), agent normalized face-diagram assembly, step 4

proof.text:
We check the normalization before inverting. Let $w_J:A	o d_{J,*}d_J^*A$ be its actual closed unit. Naturality of that unit gives $d_{J,*}d_J^*\kappa^{-1}\circ u_{J,P}\circ\kappa=w_J$. Put $\chi_J:Ra_*d_{J,*}H_{J,V}\cong g_{J,*}Ra_{J,*}H_{J,V}$ for composition. The normalization clause of [lem-sfb-root-tower-coordinate-face] and mate pasting [lem-weil-pbc-mate-pasting] give
$$\chi_J(Ra_*d_{J,*} eta_V)(Ra_*w_J)
u=(g_{J,*}\omega_J)(g_{J,*} eta_U)v_{J,P}.$$
Indeed both sides are $Rq_{P,*}$ of the restriction unit from $\mathcal N_P$ to the face $T_{J,V}[P]$: the left factors first through the outer open then its closed face; the right factors first through the closed face then its outer open. Under the composite adjunction both have transpose the identity of $\mathcal N_P|_{T_{J,V}[P]}$. The coordinate-face node identifies the closed transpose with the actual closed unit; the composition-normalization node identifies the open composite with its actual unit. Thus the preceding equality is of the specified maps. Cancel $g_{J,*}\omega_J$ and $g_{J,*} eta_U$, substitute $
u_{m all}=Ra_*\kappa
u$, and obtain $\mu_{J,P}Ra_*(u_{J,P})
u_{m all}=v_{J,P}$. Composing with $\lambda_P$ proves the required equation.

source.place: Paragraph (3), agent normalized face-diagram assembly, step 5

proof.text: For $J\subseteq J'$ the coordinate-face node identifies successive $\beta$ maps with restriction to the smaller zero-root face. Naturality of the open unit with respect to the closed-unit morphism identifies the two successive $\omega$ maps. Mate pasting [lem-weil-pbc-mate-pasting] says that either route is the mate of the same pulled-back identity on $T_{J',V}[P]$. Inserting the definitions of $\tau$ and $\mu$ therefore identifies the actual successive closed restriction maps. Together with step 5 this proves the entire augmented finite diagram. No choice of a chart in step 3 enters these maps: that cover was used only to prove that the specified $\omega_J$ is invertible.

source.place: Paragraph (3), agent normalized face-diagram assembly, step 6

proof.text: The units used above and their inverses are natural in module maps by [lem-sfb-clean-open-unit-parametrized-exchange]. The puncture and coordinate-face nodes give the same assertions for parameter maps, pro-etale base change and equivariant actions. Composition and inversion preserve each commuting square, proving these assertions for $\lambda$ and $\mu$. For a profinite family $Q$ apply those very squares on $T[P][Q]$, its opens and its faces: [lem-sfb-root-tower-profinite-base-change] identifies them with the corresponding $P\times Q$ terms. The cited nodes give equality on these entire terms; hence the composite formulas do too. For $I_o=\varnothing$, $b,b_J$ and $\nu,\omega_J$ are identities. Empty faces or charts and rank zero give zero objects and the same equations; $r=0$ admits no partition with $I_i\ne\varnothing$. No boundary trivialization or internal Hom enters.

No SGA is cited. The item statement is unchanged against live. Seven steps. (1) Nonnegative-degree injective resolutions are K-injective and left-exact pushforward preserves degrees, so H_P, K_P lie in D^{>=0}. (2) lambda is the inverse of the pushed actual bc-unit: puncture-invariance with A=I_o and A=all, clean-open-unit restriction for c, and derived-composition normalization. (3) omega_J is invertible: N_J is lisse by exact pullback and alpha-iso; the new node's charts present T_J x W as a full tower in the active parameters L over an affine pro-etale base D_W, with b_J inverting prod over I_o∩L; puncture-invariance applies on each chart; the global statement follows by open-pasting, the K-injective word model and gluing. (4) mu: coordinate-face gives beta_U and beta_V; closed images are exact because the complement union of D(t_j) is quasi-compact; I checked the typing of tau. (5) The normalization equation holds as an equality of specified arrows, using the closed-adjunct clause of coordinate-face, mate-pasting and composition normalization. (6) and (7) are elementary: nested faces, naturalities and Q-families. The new node is true: at a point, the vanishing t-bar_d are part of a regular parameter system by the SNC dimension condition; shrinking makes the rest units and the components integral; unit roots are finite etale since n is prime to p; double colimit equals diagonal colimit. I tested it on the axes in A^2 and the empty-face case. It is not a duplicate of snc-universal-residual-charts, labelled-affine-stratum-charts, snc-root-local-presentation, snc-root-stage-system or unit-root-coordinate-tower-comparison, and it is not a restated clause of the parent.
